He thought of the sailor each time it turned, a stranger now kept company by light, and the sea went on murmuring its old, indifferent song below.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市像一张尚未醒来的脸。街灯还亮着，光晕里飘着薄薄的雾气，空荡的马路上偶尔驶过一辆出租车，尾灯拖出一道红痕。早点铺的卷帘门半开，蒸笼冒着白气，老板揉着眼睛生火。远处楼群黑沉沉的，只有零星几扇窗透出微光，像疲惫者未眠的眼睛。风很轻，带着夜的凉意和清晨将至的湿润。整座城市在这一刻安静地呼吸，等待第一缕天光把它重新唤醒。", "w03": "• Recursion is when something solves a problem by using a smaller copy of the same problem.\n• Imagine standing in a line and asking the person ahead how many people are in front, each person asks the next until someone at the front says zero.\n• The answers come back one by one and add up, so the whole line gets counted by everyone doing the same tiny step."}
